en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
(zôt u râspî,) ashem vohû vahishtem
astî ... (3)! (zôt,) ashaya dadhãmi hvarethem
myazdem haurvata ameretâta gâush hudå xshnûmaine
ahurahe mazdå ameshanãm speñtanãm,
xshnûmaine sraoshahe ashyehe ashivatô verethrâjanô
frâdat-gaêthahe.
segments.en:
With a complete and sacred offering [Ashi] I offer and I give
this meat-offering, and (with it) Haurvatat (who guards the water),
and Ameretatat (who guards the plants and the wood), and the flesh
of the Kine of blessed gift, for the propitiation of Ahura Mazda,
and of the Bountiful Immortals (all, and) for the propitiation
of Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed, endowed with sanctity, who
smites with the blow of victory, and who causes the settlements
to advance.
segments.zh: 以完整而神聖的祭祀〔阿希〕我奉獻並給予這肉祭，及胡爾瓦塔特〔守護水者〕，及阿梅雷塔特〔守護植物與木者〕，及有福賜予的牲畜之肉，以供阿胡拉‧馬茲達所喜悅，及不朽聖者之所喜悅〔一切〕，以供斯魯沙〔服從〕所喜悅，彼乃有福者，具有神聖性，以勝利之擊而擊者，及使聚落前進者。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi haomemca para-haomemca xshnûmaine
zarathushtrahe spitâmahe ashaonô fravashêe,
ashaya dadhãmi aêsmã baoidhi xshnûmaine
tava âthrô ahurahe mazdå puthra.
segments.en:
And I offer the Haoma and Haoma-juice with a complete and
sacred offering for the propitiation of the Fravashi of Zarathushtra
Spitama the saint, and I offer the wood-billets with the perfume
for Thy propitiation, the Fire's, O Ahura Mazda's son!
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻豪麻及豪麻汁，以供聖者查拉圖斯特拉‧斯皮塔瑪之弗拉瓦希所喜悅，我奉獻木塊及香油以供妳所喜悅，火啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子！

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi haomi xshnûmaine aiwyô vanguhibyô
apãm vanguhînãm mazdadhâtanãm,
ashaya dadhãmi âpem haomyãm, ashaya dadhãmi
gãm jîvyãm, ashaya dadhãmi urvarãm
hadhânaêpatãm ashaya uzdâtãm xshnûmaine
apãm mazdadhâtanãm.
segments.en:
And I offer the Haomas with a complete and sacred offering
for propitiation [to the good waters] for the good waters Mazda-made.
And I offer this Haoma-water with scrupulous exactness and with
sanctity, and this fresh milk, and the plant Hadhanaepata uplifted
with a complete and sacred offering for the propitiation of the
waters which are Mazda-made.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻豪麻，以供〔善水〕所喜悅，馬茲達所製之善水。我以謹慎之準確性及神聖性奉獻此豪麻水，及此新鮮乳汁，及植物哈達那埃帕塔升起以完整而神聖的祭祀，以供馬茲達所製之水所喜悅。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi imat baresma hadha-zaothrem hadha-aiwyånghanem
ashaya frastaretem xshnûmaine ameshanãm speñtanãm,
ashaya dadhãmi vâca humata hûxta hvarshta,
ashaya dadhãmi gâthanãmca sraothrem, ashaya
dadhãmi hvarshtå mãthrå, ashaya dadhãmi
imãm anghuyãmca ashayãmca rathwãmca
ratufritîmca xshnûmaine ýazatanãm ashaonãm
mainyavanãm gaêthyanãm xshnûmaine havaheca
urunô!
segments.en:
And I offer this Baresman with its Zaothra (and with its binding)
for a girdle spread with complete sanctity and order for the propitiation
of the Bountiful Immortals, and I offer with my voice the thoughts
well-thought, the words well-spoken, and the deeds well-done,
and the heard recital of the Gathas, the Mathras well-composed
and well-delivered, and this Lordship, and this Sanctity, and
this ritual mastership, and the timely Prayer for blessings, with
a complete and sacred offering for the propitiation of the holy
Yazads, heavenly and earthly, and for the contentment of the individual
soul!
segments.zh:
我以巴爾什農及其薩歐塔拉（及其束縛）獻祭。
為一條以完全聖性和秩序延展的腰帶而獻祭，以求懇禱
不朽聖者，我以我的聲音獻祭思想
善思、善言、善行，
及伽薩的誦唸，妥帖組成
妥帖傳達的贊歌，及此統治權，及此聖性，及
此禮儀的主宰，以及及時的祝福祈禱，同時
為聖潔者的完整而神聖的供奉
天地之間的雅茲德們，以及個人靈魂的滿足
而獻！

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi asnyaêibyô ashahe ratubyô,
hâvanêe ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi
sâvanghêe vîsyâica ashaone ashahe rathwe,
ashaya dadhãmi mithrahe vouru-gaoyaotôish hazangrô-
gaoshahe baêvare-cashmanô aoxtô-nâmanô
ýazatahe râmanô hvâstrahe.
segments.en:
And I offer to the Asnya with a complete and sacred offering,
as lords of the ritual order, and to Havani, and to Savanghi and
Visya, holy lords of the ritual order, and to Mithra of the wide
pastures, of the thousand ears, and myriad eyes, the Yazad of
the spoken name, and to Raman Hvastra.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻於阿斯尼亞，如儀式秩序之主，及於哈瓦尼，及於薩瓦尼及維西亞，儀式秩序之聖主，及於廣大牧地之密特拉，千耳者，無數眼者，名字之雅贊德，及於拉曼‧赫瓦斯特拉。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi rapithwinâi ashaone ashahe rathwe,
ashaya dadhãmi frâdat-fshave zañtumâica
ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi ashahe vahishtahe
âthrasca ahurahe mazdå.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Rapithwina,
the holy lord of the ritual order; and I offer to Fradat-fshu
and to the Zantuma, and to Asha Vahishta (who is Righteousness
the Best) and to Ahura Mazda's Fire.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻於拉皮什維納，儀式秩序之聖主；我奉獻於弗拉達特-夫舒及於贊圖瑪，及於阿沙‧瓦希什塔〔阿沙最美者〕及於阿胡拉‧馬茲達之火。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi uzayeirinâi ashaone ashahe rathwe,
ashaya dadhãmi frâdat-vîrâi dâh'yumâica
ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi berezatô ahurahe
nafedhrô apãm apasca mazdadhâtayå.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Uzayeirina,
Fradat-vira, and to the Dahvyuma*, the holy lord of the ritual
order, and to that lofty Ahura Napat-apam, and to the waters which
Mazda created.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻於烏扎耶伊里納，弗拉達特-維拉，及於達赫尤瑪，儀式秩序之聖主，及於此高大阿胡拉‧納帕特-阿帕姆，及於馬茲達所創造之水。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi aiwisrûthrimâi aibigayâi
ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi frâdat-vîspãm-hujyâtêe
zarathushtrôtemâica ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya
dadhãmi ashâunãm fravashinãm khenãnãmca
vîrô-vãthwanãm ýâiryayåsca
hushitôish amaheca hutâshtahe huraodhahe verethrakhnaheca
ahuradhâtahe vanaiñtyåsca uparatâtô.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Aiwisruthrima,
the life-furtherer, and to Fradat-vispam-hujyaiti, and to the
Zarathushtrotema, and to the Fravashis of the saints, and to the
women who have many sons, and to the Prosperous home-life which
endures (without reverse) throughout the year, and to Force, the
well-shaped and stately, and to the Blow which smites with victory
Ahura-given, and to the Victorious Ascendency (which it secures).
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻於艾維斯魯特里瑪，生命之推進者，及於弗拉達特-維斯帕姆-胡傑亞提，及於查拉圖斯特羅特瑪，及於聖者之弗拉瓦希，及於生有眾子之婦女，及於繁榮之家庭生活，全年無倒轉而長存者，及於力量，美好成形者、莊嚴者，及於擊打者，以勝利之擊而擊，阿胡拉所賜者，及於勝利之優越〔其所保證〕。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi ushahinâi ashaone ashahe rathwe,
ashaya dadhãmi berejyâi nmânyâica ashaone
ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi sraoshahe ashyehe ashivatô
verethrâjanô frâdat-gaêthahe rashnaosh
razishtahe arshtâtasca frâdat-gaêthayå
varedat-gaêthayå!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Ushahina,
the holy lord of the ritual order, and to Berejya, and Nmanya,
and to Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed, endowed with sanctity,
who smites with the blow of victory, and makes the settlements
advance, and to Rashnu the most just, and to Arshtat who furthers
the settlements and causes them to increase.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祭祀奉獻於烏莎希納，儀式秩序之聖主，及於貝雷傑亞及尼瑪尼亞，及於斯魯沙〔服從〕所喜悅，彼乃有福者，具有神聖性，以勝利之擊而擊者，及使聚落前進者，及於至公正之拉什努，及於阿爾什塔特，推進聚落者及使其增長者。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi mâhyaêibyô ashahe
ratubyô, añtaremånghâi ashaone ashahe
rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi perenô-månghâi
vîshaptathâica ashaone ashahe rathwe!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to the Mahya,
lords of the ritual order, to the new and the waning moon (the
moon within), and to the full moon which scatters night, holy
lords of the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給月神們，禮儀秩序的主宰們，獻給新月與殘月（月之內），以及光滿之月，它驅散黑暗，禮儀秩序的聖主們。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi ýâiryaêibyô
ashahe ratubyô, maidhyôizaremayâi ashaone ashahe
rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi maidhyôishemâi ashaone
ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi paitishhahyâi ashaone
ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi ayâthrimâi fraourvaêshtrimâi
varshniharshtâica ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi
maidhyâiryâi ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi
hamaspathmaêdayâi ashaone ashahe rathwe, ashaya dadhãmi
saredhaêibyô ashahe ratubyô.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to the Yearly
festivals, the lords of the ritual order, to Maidhyo-zaremaya,
and Maidhyo-shema, to Paitishahya, and to Ayathrima the furtherer
(the breeder), the spender of the strength of males, and to Maidhyairya
and Hamaspathmaedhaya, holy lords of the ritual order, and I offer
with sanctity to the several seasons, the lords of the ritual
order.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給年度節慶，禮儀秩序的主宰們，獻給邁德雍‧扎雷瑪亞和邁德雍‧舍瑪，獻給帕伊蒂沙雅和阿亞特里瑪促進者（孕育者），男性力量的揮霍者，以及邁德雍‧艾里亞和哈瑪斯帕特馬埃達亞，禮儀秩序的聖主們，我以神聖性獻給諸季節，禮儀秩序的主宰們。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi vîspaêibyô aêibyô
ratubyô ýôi heñti ashahe ratavô
thrayasca thrisãsca nazdishta pairishhâvanayô
ýôi heñti ashahe ýat vahishtahe mazdô-frasâsta
zarathushtrô-fraoxta!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to all those
lords who are the thirty and three, who approach the nearest round
about our Havani, and who are the lords of Asha (the ritual by-eminence),
of Righteousness who is (the Best), whose observances are inculcated
as precepts by Mazda, and uttered forth by Zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給所有那些主宰們，三十三位，他們在我們的哈瓦尼周圍最近處靠近，他們是阿沙（卓越的禮儀）的主宰，正義的主宰（最美好的），他們的教規由馬茲達所教導，由查拉圖斯特拉所宣說。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi ahuraêibya mithraêibya berezañbya
aithyajanghaêibya ashavanaêibya stârãmca
speñtô-mainyavanãm dâmanãm tishtryeheca
stârô raêvatô hvarenanguhatô månghaheca
gaocithrahe hvareca xshaêtahe aurvat-aspahe dôithrahe
ahurahe mazdå mithrahe dah'yunãm dainghupatôish,
ashaya dadhãmi (...rôz...) ahurahe mazdå raêvatô
hvarenanguhatô, ashaya dadhãmi ( ... mâh ...
) ashâunãm fravashinãm!
segments.en:
And
I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Ahura and Mithra,
the lofty and imperishable, and holy two, and to the stars which
are the creatures of Spenta Mainyu, and to the star Tishtrya,
the radiant, the glorious, and to the Moon which contains the
seed of cattle in its beams, and to the resplendent Sun of the
fleet horses, the eye of Ahura Mazda, and to Mithra, the lord
of the provinces. And I offer with a complete and sacred offering
to Ahura Mazda, the resplendent, the glorious, (who rules this
day), and to the Fravashis of the saints (who name the month).
segments.zh:
而且
我以完整而神聖的供奉獻於阿胡拉及密特拉，
崇高而不朽的，和聖潔的二位，以及眾星，
乃斯彭塔‧曼紐的造物，及星辰蒂什特里亞，
光輝的、榮耀的，以及月亮，其光中蘊含著
牲畜的種子，以及光耀的太陽，
快馬、阿胡拉‧馬茲達的眼睛，以及密特拉、諸州之主
。而我以完整而神聖的獻祭向
阿胡拉‧馬茲達、光耀者、榮耀者（統治此
日）以及聖人的弗拉瓦希（命名此月者）獻上。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi tava âthrô ahurahe mazdå
puthra mat vîspaêibyô âterebyô,
ashaya dadhãmi aiwyô vanguhibyô vîspanãmca
apãm mazdadhâtanãm vîspanãmca
urvaranãm mazdadhâtanãm!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to thee, the
Fire, O Ahura Mazda's son! together with all the fires, and to
the good waters, even to the waters which are Mazda-made, and
to all the plants which Mazda made.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給你，火焰啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的兒子啊！連同所有的火焰，以及良好的水，即馬茲達所造的水，以及所有馬茲達所造的植物。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi mãthrahe speñtahe ashaonô
verezyanguhahe dâtahe vîdaêvahe dâtahe
zarathushtrôish darekhayå upayanayå daênayå
vanghuyå mâzdayasnôish.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to the Mathra
Spenta, the holy, the effective, revealed against the Daevas,
the Zarathushtrian law, and to the long descent of the good Religion,
of the Mazdayasnian faith.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給聖教言，神聖的、有效的，針對達埃瓦而示現的，查拉圖斯特拉的律法，以及良好宗教的悠久傳承，瑪茲達信仰的信德。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi garôish ushidarenahe mazdadhâtahe
ashahvâthrahe vîspaêshãmca gairinãm
ashahvâthranãm pouru-hvâthranãm mazdadhâtanãm
kâvayeheca hvarenanghô mazdadhâtahe ahvaretaheca
hvarenanghô mazdadhâtahe, ashaya dadhãmi ashôish
vanghuyå cistôish vanghuyå erethê vanghuyå
rasãstâtô vanghuyå hvarenanghô
savanghô mazdadhâtahe.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to Mount Ushi-darena,
the Mazda-made, brilliant with holiness, and to all the mountains
shining with holiness, of abundant brightness, and which Mazda
made, and to the Royal glory unconsumed and Mazda-made. And I
offer with a complete and sacred offering to Ashi Vanguhi, and
to Chishti Vanguhi, and to Erethe, and to Rasastat, and to the
Glory (and the) Benefit which Mazda made.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給烏希‧達雷納山，馬茲達所造，以聖性光輝熠熠，以及所有以聖性光輝閃耀的山嶺，豐富光耀的，馬茲達所造的，以及王家榮光不滅而馬茲達所造的。我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給阿希‧萬古希，以及奇斯提‧萬古希，以及埃雷特，以及拉薩塔特，以及榮光與福利，馬茲達所造的。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi dahmayå vanghuyå âfritôish
dahmaheca narsh ashaonô ukhraheca taxmahe dâmôish
upamanahe ýazatahe!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to the good
and pious Prayer for blessings of the pious man, and to that Yazad,
the swift and dreadful Curse of the wise.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的奉獻獻給敬虔人的良好而敬虔的祝福祈禱，以及那位雅札特，迅疾而可怖的詛咒，屬於智者的。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi ånghãm asanghãmca
shôithranãmca gaoyaoitinãmca maêthananãmca
avô-hvarenanãmca apãmca zemãmca urvaranãmca
ainghåsca zemô avaingheca ashnô vâtaheca
ashaonô strãm månghô hûrô
anakhranãm raocanghãm hvadhâtanãm vîspanãmca
speñtahe mainyêush dâmanãm ashaonãm
ashaoninãmca ashahe rathwãm.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred blessing to these places, 
districts, pastures, and abodes with their springs of water, and
to the waters and the lands, and the plants, and to this earth
and yon heaven, and to the holy wind, and to the stars, and the
moon, even to the stars without beginning (to their course), the
self-appointed, and to all the holy creatures of Spenta Mainyu,
be they male or female, regulators (as they are) of the ritual
order.
segments.zh: 我以完整而神聖的祝福獻給這些地方、地區、牧場和居所帶其水泉，以及水和地，以及植物，以及此地與彼天，以及聖風，以及群星和月亮，甚至無始之星（在其運行中），自任的，以及斯彭塔‧曼紐的所有聖造物，無論男性或女性，禮儀秩序的規範者（正如他們所是）。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi rathwô berezatô ýô
ashahe, rathwãm ayaranãmca asnyanãmca mâhyanãmca
ýâiryanãmca saredhanãmca ýôi
heñti ashahe ratavô, hâvanôish rathwô!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred blessing to that lofty
lord who is Righteousness (the Best) and the Day-lords, the lords
of the days during their duration, and to those of the days during
daylight, and to the Month-lords, and the Year-lords, and to those
of the seasons, the lords who are lords of the ritual, and at
the time of Havani.
segments.zh: 我以完整和神聖的祝福獻祭給那至高的主宰，他是正義（最善者），以及日主，在他們存續期間的日主，以及在日光之中的那些日主，以及月主，以及年主，以及季節的那些主宰，他們是禮儀的主宰，在哈瓦尼時刻。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi (zôt u râspî,) hvarethem
myazdem haurvata ameretâta gâush hudå xshnûmaine
sraoshahe ashyehe taxmahe tanumãthrahe darshi-draosh âhûiryehe
aoxtô-nâmanô ýazatahe.
segments.en:
And I offer the Myazda meat-offering with a complete and sacred
offering, and Haurvatat (who guards the water), and Ameretatat
(who guards the wood), and the flesh of the Kine of blessed gift,
for the propitiation of Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed, whose
body is the Mathra, him of the daring spear, the lordly, the Yazad
of the spoken name.
segments.zh: 我以完整和神聖的獻祭獻祭米亞茲達肉祭，以及胡爾瓦塔特（守護水者），以及阿梅雷塔特（守護木者），以及有福賜予的牲畜的肉體，為了酬謝斯魯沙（服從）那被祝福的，他的身體是瑪特拉，那大膽持矛者，那尊貴的，那被誦名的亞茲德。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi haomemca para-haomemca xshnûmaine
zarathushtrahe spitâmahe ashaonô fravashêe aoxtô-nâmanô
ýazatahe, ashaya dadhãmi aêsma baoidhi xshnûmaine
tava âthrô ahurahe mazdå puthra aoxtô-nâmanô
ýazatahe. (ashaya dadhãmi hvarethem myazdem ...
ýazatahe (2).)
segments.en:
And I offer the Haoma and the Haoma-juice for the propitiation
of the Fravashi of Zarathushtra Spitama the saint, the Yazad of
the spoken name.
And I offer the wood-billets with the perfume for Thy propitiation,
the Fire's, Ahura Mazda's son, the Yazad of the spoken name.
segments.zh: 我獻祭豪麻和豪麻汁，為了酬謝查拉圖斯特拉‧斯皮塔瑪聖者的弗拉瓦希，那被誦名的亞茲德。我獻祭帶著香氣的木片，為了酬謝你，火啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子，那被誦名的亞茲德。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi ashâunãm fravashinãm
ukhranãm aiwithûranãm paoiryô-tkaêshanãm
fravashinãm nabânazdishtanãm fravashinãm.
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to the Fravashis
of the saints, the mighty and overwhelming, to those of the saints
of the ancient lore, and to those of the next of kin.
segments.zh: 我以完整和神聖的獻祭獻祭於聖者的弗拉瓦希，那些強大而壓倒一切的，那些古代智慧的聖者的弗拉瓦希，以及那些近親的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
ashaya dadhãmi vîspaêibyô ashahe
ratubyô, ashaya dadhãmi vîspaêibyô
vanghudhâbyô ýazataêibyô mainyaoibyascâ
gaêthyaêibyascâ ýôi heñti
ýasnyâca vahmyâca ashât haca ýat
vahishtât!
segments.en:
And I offer with a complete and sacred offering to all the
lords of the ritual order, and to all the good Yazads heavenly
and earthly who are (meet) for sacrifice and homage because of
Asha who is Vahishta (of Righteousness who is the Best).
segments.zh: 我以完整和神聖的獻祭獻祭於禮儀秩序的所有主宰，以及所有善良的亞茲德，天上的和地上的，他們因正義（最善者）的阿沙而配受犧牲和敬禮。

segments.orig:
ashaya-nô paitî jamyât ýehyâ
savâ ishåñtî râdanghô, thwôi
staotarascâ mãthranascâ ahura-mazdâ aogemadaêcâ
usmahicâ vîsâmadaêcâ, hyat mîzhdem
mavaêthem fradadâthâ daênâbyô
mazdâ ahurâ, (thwôi staotarascâ ... mazdâ
ahurâ (2).)
segments.en:
May that approach to us, and with a sacred blessing (O Lord!)
whose benefits the offerers are seeking for. Thy praisers and
Mathra-speakers, O Ahura Mazda! may we be named; we desire it,
and such may we be. What reward, O Ahura Mazda! adapted to myself
Thou hast appointed unto souls,
segments.zh: 願那靠近我們，帶著神聖的祝福（主啊！），獻祭者們所尋求的益處也隨之而來。主啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！願我們被稱為你的讚美者和瑪特拉誦者；我們渴望這樣，願我們真是如此。阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！什麼酬賞，適配於我自己，你已為靈魂指定，

segments.orig:
ahyâ hvô nê dâidî ahmâicâ
ahuyê manah'yâica, tat ahyâ ýâ
tat upâ jamyâmâ tavâcâ sarem ashah'yâcâ
vîspâi ýavê. ýathâ ahû
vairyô athâ ratush ashâtcît hacâ
... (2)!
segments.en:
Of this do Thou Thyself bestow upon us for this world and
for that of mind; (yea, do Thou bestow) so much of this as that
we may attain to Thy ruling protection and to that of Righteousness
for ever.
segments.zh: 這酬賞願你自己賜予我們，為了這世界和心靈的世界；（是的，願你賜予）這麼多酬賞，好讓我們能達到你的統治保護和正義永遠的保護。

segments.orig:
ahunem vairîm ýazamaide, arshuxdhem vâcim
ýazamaide, dahmãm vanguhîm âfritîm
ýazamaide, ukhrem taxmem dâmôish upamanem ýazatem
ýazamaide, haurvata ameretâta ýazamaide, gâush
hudå ýazamaide, haomemca para-haomemca ýazamaide,
aêsmãsca baoidhîmca ýazamaide, frasasti
dahmayå vanghuyå âfritôish!
segments.en:
We sacrifice to the Ahuna-vairya and to the veracious word
correctly uttered, and to the good and pious prayer for blessings,
and to the dreadful curse of the wise, the Yazad, and to Haurvatat
and Ameretatat, and to the flesh of the Kine of blessed gift,
and to the Haoma and Haoma-juice, and to the wood-billets, and
the perfume, for the praise of the pious and good prayer for blessings.
(The Yenghe hatam:)
segments.zh: 我們獻祭於阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，以及被正確誦說的真實言語，以及善良和虔誠的祝福禱告，以及睿智者可怖的詛咒，亞茲德，以及胡爾瓦塔特和阿梅雷塔特，以及有福賜予的牲畜的肉體，以及豪麻和豪麻汁，以及木片和香氣，為了讚美虔誠和善良的祝福禱告。（英赫‧哈塔：）

segments.orig:
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide.
segments.en:
(To that one) of beings do we sacrifice whose superior (fidelity)
in the sacrifice Ahura Mazda knows through his Righteousness (within
him, yea, even to those female saints do we sacrifice) whose (superior
sanctity is thus known. We sacrifice to all) both males and females
whose (superiority is such).
(The Ratu speaks.) As an Ahu (revered and) to be chosen, he who is the Zaotar speaks
forth to me.
(The Zaotar.) So let the Ratu from his Righteousness, holy and learned, speak
forth!
<H2 id=y8
segments.zh:
（對那樣的生靈）我們獻祭，其在獻祭中的卓越（忠誠）為阿胡拉‧馬茲達通過其內在的正義所知悉（是的，甚至對那些女聖人我們獻祭），其（卓越的聖性如此為人所知）。我們獻祭給所有（卓越性如此）的男性和女性。
（儀式主持者說）身為應被敬重和選擇的阿胡，身為祭司的他向我說話。
（祭司說）那麼願儀式主持者從其正義出發，聖潔而博學地向我說話！

segments.orig:
(râspî,) ýathâ ahû vairyô
ýô zaotâ frâ-mê mrûtê,
(zôt,) athâ ratush ashâtcît haca frâ
ashava vîdhvå mraotû!!
